thread:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — planning a canary for inference-service v2.3 in us-west-2 today 15:00 PT. Goal: validate batching and kv-cache under real traffic. Ramp plan: 1% -> 5% after 10m -> 20% after 30m if metrics look good. Need smoke owners and rollback ready.
Sam Kim: I can own the initial smoke checks. Will be at my desk. Which routes are in scope? :eyes:
Maya Patel: Thanks Sam. Scope: /v1/generate, /v1/stream, embeddings. Excluding admin endpoints. Priority checks: p95 latency, error rate, memory OOMs.
Priya Nair: What are the gating thresholds? I can wire a dashboard alert.
Maya Patel: Gating: error rate < 0.5% (5xx), p95 latency < 450ms, GPU mem headroom > 200MB per pod. If any breach -> pause ramp and notify oncall.
Leo Gomez: I'll be ready to rollback. How do you want to trigger rollback? Manual via deploy console or automated at X%?
Maya Patel: Manual rollback for this run. Sam or Julie should confirm fail and then I'll flip the release button. Keep a note of the cohort IDs to revert traffic. :thumbsup:
Julie Chen: I'll monitor traces and slow queries. If things look off I will post a clear "pause" message here and tag @oncall.
deploy-bot: Canary started for inference-service:v2.3 (cohort internal-1) — 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z
Sam Kim: Smoke checklist (I'm running):
```
1) curl healthcheck: curl -sS https://us-west-2-api.redwood.dev/health
2) quick generate: curl -sS -X POST https://us-west-2-api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
3) inspect pod logs: kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference --tail=200
```
Priya Nair: Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.dev/dashboards/canary-v2.3. I'll mute noisy alerts but unmute gating ones. Ping me if metrics approach thresholds.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. Next ramp to 5% scheduled +10m if green. I'll post updates here. If you want to be assigned a cohort to validate, say so.
Leo Gomez: I'll validate cache hit rates for cohort internal-2 at 5% — ping me at ramp.
Julie Chen: Will post traces and sample outputs at each ramp. Good luck :rocket:
Maya Patel: Update: 1% steady for 8m, no errors, p95 320ms, proceeding to 5% in 2m.
deploy-bot: Traffic window moved to 5% for inference-service:v2.3 (cohort internal-2) — 2026-03-17T22:12:00Z
Sam Kim: 5% looks clean. No new errors, mem ok. Proceed to 20% in 15m.
Maya Patel: Copy. If anything, call it out as "pause" or "rollback" and tag @oncall. End of thread will have final status.
